subject: Silvergate CAIQ walkthrough & evidence handoff
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: John Dunham <john.dunham@silvergate.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Apr 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Silvergate CAIQ walkthrough & evidence handoff

Hi John —

Thanks again for taking the time to evaluate Redwood. To make the SIG/CAIQ review efficient, we'd like to run a 45‑minute walkthrough focused on the CAIQ responses and the evidence handoff process. During the call we can:
- Walk through our completed CAIQ draft (high level)
- Clarify any controls you flagged as high priority
- Agree owners and timelines for evidence (logs, network diagrams, policies, attestation)

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Wed 2025-04-30 10:00–10:45
- Wed 2025-04-30 15:00–15:45

If neither works, propose a time that suits your team.

Pre-call requests to help us prepare:
1) Can you share the list of Silvergate evidence types you typically require (e.g., net diagrams, retention config, SOC 2 report)?
2) If you need sample logs, let us know preferred time window and log format (we can provide app/gw logs or a short sample export).
3) Any NDAs or pre-call paperwork we should complete?

Attaching: redwood_caiq_template.xlsx (working draft) and a short upload guide.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_caiq_template.xlsx, redwood_caiq_instructions.pdf
From: John Dunham <john.dunham@silvergate.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@silvergate.com
Date: Mon, 28 Apr 2025 12:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Silvergate CAIQ walkthrough & evidence handoff

Karthik —

Appreciate the fast turnaround. Wed 2025-04-30 15:00 ET (which I believe is 12:00 PT) would work for two of our InfoSec engineers. Can you confirm the timezone (your slots looked like PDT)?

For the intake we typically request:
- Latest SOC 2 Type II report (if available)
- Network/topology diagram showing ingress/egress points and 3rd‑party integrations
- Data retention policy and log retention configuration (SIEM/ELK or S3 paths)
- Sample auth audit log (30–60 minutes of events) with timestamps (UTC)
- List of sub‑processors and regions where customer data is processed

We can accept a presigned S3 link or a secure Teams/SharePoint upload. Please also include a single point of contact for evidence questions.

Note: we required a short NDA before receiving customer data last time — I can send our standard one if needed.

Thanks,
John Dunham
Head of Information Security
Silvergate
Attachments: silvergate_network_diagram.png
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: John Dunham <john.dunham@silvergate.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Apr 2025 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Silvergate CAIQ walkthrough & evidence handoff

John —

Thanks — apologies for the timezone mix. My slots were in PDT; the Wed 04-30 12:00 PDT / 15:00 EDT slot works for us. I just sent a calendar invite: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/xe8f4b2/caiq-walkthrough (invite includes dial in + Zoom link).

Action items ahead of the call:
- Redwood will upload: redwood_caiq_template.xlsx (completed draft), redwood_caiq_instructions.pdf, and a 60‑minute sample auth log (UTC) to a presigned S3 link.
- Silvergate to confirm whether your NDA is needed; if so, please share and we'll route it to Legal.
- We'll map evidence owners in the CAIQ — Marissa will be the internal owner for logs and SIEM exports; Ben will handle network topology artifacts.

Ownership mapping (preliminary):
- Logs/SIEM: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
- Network diagrams & infra: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
- Controls clarifications / product behavior: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>

We will prepare the presigned S3 link and send it to you by EOD tomorrow. If Silvergate prefers SharePoint instead, confirm and we'll switch.

Best,
Karthik

Date: Wed, 30 Apr 2025 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Silvergate CAIQ walkthrough & evidence handoff (upload logistics)

John —

Confirmed for today 12:00 PDT / 15:00 EDT. Quick upload logistics so we don't lose time on the call:
- We will create a presigned S3 bucket with separate folders: /silvergate/caiq/ and /silvergate/logs/sample1/
- Files we will upload by 20:00 UTC tonight: redwood_caiq_template.xlsx, redwood_caiq_instructions.pdf, sample_auth_log_20250428_utc.log (60m)
- If Silvergate prefers SharePoint, please send the upload URL and a contact who can provision permissions; otherwise I'll send the presigned S3 link to your team distribution list (security@silvergate.com).

On the call we'll run through the CAIQ rows where Silvergate has marked 'clarify' or 'evidence required' and assign a target owner and due date. Expect the following internal owners to appear in the CAIQ:
- Controls: Product/Infra – Ben Carter
- Logs & Monitoring – Marissa Cole
- Legal/Contracts clarifications – Karthik (will loop Legal as needed)

If you can send the NDA now, I can push it through Legal for review ASAP.

Thanks — see you on the call.

Marissa Cole
Security & CSM Liaison
Redwood Inference
Attachments: none
